2482fd14fb.q: How much crude oil is required to manufacture a conventional queen-size polyurethane mattress?
2482fd14fb.a: A conventional queen-size bed with polyurethane foam inside requires 20 gallons of crude oil to make that polyurethane foam. Polyurethane foam is sometimes called solid gasoline because it ignites easily even with cancer-causing flame-retardant chemicals inside.

6099f58750.q: Which four US states have mandatory mattress recycling programs and what is the consumer recycling fee?
6099f58750.a: Only four states—California, Connecticut, Oregon, and Rhode Island—have laws requiring mattress recycling programs run under the Mattress Recycling Council. A small recycling fee gets added at the point of sale, usually between $16 to $22 depending on the state.
